feature_contract.goal: Finish the complete F11 input-to-font-to-shell function by synchronizing first visible legacy/new-input frame, native-eye raster density, shell/control focus and durable settings behavior through opening and closing.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: F11 external ImGui overlay only: preserve gameplay HUD, R30 binocular geometry, world/vehicle rendering, SkyGlow, DX11, DXVK and FFB.
trace_stages: F11 original Win32 release and bound action input captured before EndScene font selection
Overlay prediction drives XR eye-density font atlas and responsive shell and ImGui control state
R30 external overlay draw keeps binocular semantic projection and restores desktop presentation on close
subcomponents: One-poll-per-frame legacy and new-input edge with close/open and binding dialog protection
Shared visibility decision for XR raster font density, native shell layout, ImGui render and cursor ownership
Seeded mode/Reset/focus/save behavior and mutation checks integrated into exact-SHA Win32 CI

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Legacy F11 and bound actions rasterise the correct XR-density atlas on the first visible frame and switch to desktop density on close.
Held bound action never repeats; dialog suppresses legacy close; XR source/eye dropout retains atlas while desktop fallback and existing F11 persistence/focus tests remain intact.
Both source-bound F11 regression verifiers and exact-SHA DX9Ex Active/Domain/Full Source Impact Win32 gates pass, with HMD validation separate.

diagnosis.original_evidence: Current D3DEndScene computes VR font density from prior overlayActive or held bound action; legacy F11 release is consumed later inside render(), so the first visible legacy frame misses the new eye atlas, and a closing bound action can still prewarm one.
diagnosis.root_cause: Two independent checks drive source font density and actual F11 render visibility on different edges and frames.
source_trace: Win32 legacy ImGui F11 release or InputManager action edge at EndScene
ImGui font density rebuild before Overlay::render() visibility/cursor change
F11 external SCREEN_OVERLAY_2D projection into eye composition
alternatives_rejected: Do not change eye-based rasterisation for all HUD and 3D draws.
Do not double-consume a held action edge in preflight and render.
Do not change user's accepted F11 stereo semantics or introduce new device Reset probes.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: The F11 external overlay has separate ScreenOverlay2D ownership while the raster is native to source and both eyes receive the established corrected projection.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Source-bound seeded desktop/new-input/legacy/dialog/open/close/Reset/hysteresis cases plus mutation controls; GitHub validation pending.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Shared pure OverlayToggleFrame prediction polled only once before atlas selection and consumed in render.

full_source_impact.note: Full Source Impact analyzes source-changing material SHA; subsequent same-task validation-bearing commits only repair Python verification guards.
